data.body: rebar-debug evidence update: Runtime proof established two root-propagation defects. RunnerAgentStep and direct review_ticket loaded repository prompt metadata with a root but re-rendered the body without that same root, producing an empty project-only prompt. The code-review gate also computed an attested cfg.repo_path but passed the original live/None request root into project-criterion membership and batch validation, so an attested prompt could be skipped or rejected before the LLM. A sibling in scan_epics_for_spec had the same metadata/body split. RED/GREEN/mutation coverage now exercises all paths, including live-vs-snapshot metadata, body, criterion membership, and local fallback. The unchanged 8ac3d3c replay now completes the full gate, but the project finder abstains 5/5 in isolation because that changed clause does not satisfy the tightened three-part grounding instruction; its surviving advisory is therefore built-in, not lost project identity. A strict project FIRE fixture run through the same full four-pass workflow produced a surviving advisory with reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria project.review-phase-boundaries, block_threshold 0.9, and blocking_enabled false. This proves attribution survives through Pass 3 when the project finder emits. No voting or review-process semantics were changed.
